llm.summary: The skill provides purpose-aligned, read-only Zhihu research through SocialDataX, with ordinary third-party service and software dependency risks.

dimensions.detail: Node/npm, a SocialDataX API key, and submitting lookup inputs are proportionate to this integration. The named provider and explicit command arguments make this expected data flow; the privacy warning does not establish hidden collection. The publisher's [CLI source](https://github.com/DevinChen2014/socialdatax-skills/blob/main/cli.mjs) corroborates the SocialDataX Zhihu endpoint.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The metadata and examples openly use the SocialDataX npm package without a fixed version. This creates dependency trust exposure, but no artifact evidence supports malicious execution. Repeated scanner matches describe the same mechanism; the 'npx availability' match is ordinary troubleshooting prose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay within research and troubleshooting. Dependency repairs must respect existing user authorization, and broader system changes require approval.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact requests no background workers, persistent hooks, elevated privileges, or unrelated credential access. Pagination recovery preserves existing limits and avoids repeated insufficient-balance requests.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Search, content retrieval, comments, and creator lookups fit the stated research purpose. The artifact explicitly excludes browser-data access, login, posting, and account changes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: SocialDataX receives your lookup inputs and uses your API key; avoid including private information and consider service charges when requesting many pages. Prefer a reviewed, fixed CLI version over @latest. The external executable was not run or fully audited.
